cohort: 97 women with IBD who delivered 130 babies at the CWIUH from 2011 to 2016
finding: Contraindication to neuraxial blockade in laboring women with IBD does not significantly influence mode of delivery, despite increased need for alternative pain management strategies and prophylactic haemostatic support.
mod_finding: Women with contraindications to regional anesthesia had similar rates of vaginal birth and cesarean section compared to those without contraindications.
